description: A small reinforcing band worked or attached at the head and tail of a textblock to take the strain of pulling a volume from a shelf. It is built up from a core of vellum, gut, or cord wrapped with coloured silk or thread, and is set so that it sits slightly below the level of the boards.
name: headband

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter XI, p.147. Internet Archive.
